name: expected_vs_unexpected_paired_eval
description: Held-out paired ASNE contrast with matched wording for routine scene continuations versus unlikely scene continuations.

items.text: A person puts a notebook on a desk. A moment later, the notebook remains on the desk.
Someone places a mug beside the sink. A moment later, the mug is still beside the sink.
A person leaves a bag on a bench. A moment later, the bag is still on the bench.
A person puts a notebook on a desk. A moment later, the notebook is inside the freezer.
Someone places a mug beside the sink. A moment later, the mug is hanging from a lamp.
A person leaves a bag on a bench. A moment later, the bag is balanced on a ceiling fan.
